verifications.claim: 5G is the fifth-generation global wireless standard.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '5G is the 5th generation mobile network. It is a new global wireless standard'; R6: '5G is the fifth generation of cellular network technology'; R8: '5G is the fifth generation of mobile technology'; R10: 'Fifth-generation wireless or 5G is a global standard'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state 5G as the fifth-generation global wireless/cellular standard.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'up to 20 Gigabits-per-second (Gbps) peak data rates', 'up to 10 Gbps'; R4: 'theoretical peak speed of 20 Gbps'; R5: 'speeds up to 20 Gbps'; R6: 'up to 10 Gbps... Theoretical peak download speeds reach up to 20 Gbit/s'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm peak speeds in the 10-20 Gbps range.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'mmWave (e.g., 24 GHz and up), which will bring extreme capacity'; R5: 'high-band... mmWave 5G'; R6: 'Frequency Range 2 (FR2) – 24–71 GHz, known as millimeter wave or high band'
